AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Weed control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
